game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Tavern Terrace Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace, a seaside tavern terrace: the fisher must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Tavern Terrace: a seaside tavern terrace
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Terrace, repeat each round: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the fisher ahead. Then check the cover value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the treasure chest by solving code steps involving cover that move the fisher forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.2).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the treasure chest first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 9 (extended tier): Patrol Decision Tree
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Patrol Decision Tree' (Week 3 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Tavern Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cover changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smugglers in Tavern Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.2).
